headline: Tk 34,497cr project: Padma Barrage construction to begin in early 2027
summary: Water Resources Minister Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee says the 2.1km long barrage will transform the economy of 24 southwestern districts.
details: Water Resources Minister Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee announced that construction of the Padma Barrage will begin in early 2027, with Prime Minister Tarique Rahman expected to inaugurate the work between January and March.
The project, approved by the BNP government at a cost of Tk 34,497 crore, will be implemented using government funds over the next seven years.
The 2.1-kilometre-long barrage will feature 78 spillway gates, 18 undersluice gates, one navigation lock, and two fish passes, along with a railway bridge constructed over it.
Minister Anee stated that the barrage will transform the economy of 24 southwestern districts by bringing major changes to the agriculture and fisheries sectors.
The project will also include two hydroelectric power plants, each with a capacity of 113 megawatts, each contributing to the energy sector.
According to the minister, the barrage will help control river erosion during the monsoon and resolve water shortages during the lean period.
Additionally, the project is intended to protect the ecosystem of the Sundarbans.
The technical survey for the project originally began in 2004 under the prime ministership of Begum Khaleda Zia.
caption:
A Tk 34,497 crore project to transform 24 southwestern districts is coming.

Water Resources Minister Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee announced that construction of the Padma Barrage will begin in early 2027, with Prime Minister Tarique Rahman expected to inaugurate the work between January and March.

The project, approved by the BNP government at a cost of Tk 34,497 crore, will be implemented using government funds over the next seven years.

The 2.1-kilometre-long barrage will feature 78 spillway gates, 18 undersluice gates, one navigation lock, and two fish passes, along with a railway bridge constructed over it.

Minister Anee stated that the barrage will transform the economy of 24 southwestern districts by bringing major changes to the agriculture and fisheries sectors.

The project will also include two hydroelectric power plants, each with a capacity of 113 megawatts, each contributing to the energy sector.

According to the minister, the barrage will help control river erosion during the monsoon and resolve water shortages during the lean period.

Additionally, the project is intended to protect the ecosystem of the Sundarbans.

The technical survey for the project originally began in 2004 under the prime ministership of Begum Khaleda Zia.

headline: 63 foreigners arrested over online fraud in Chattogram
summary: Police raided a building in the Khulshi area, uncovering an international scam ring operating with numerous electronic devices.
details: The Counter Terrorism Unit (CTU) of the city police and Khulshi police arrested 63 foreign nationals in the Khulshi area of Chattogram city.
The suspects were found operating an international online fraud ring from a single building.
During the raid, police discovered various electronic devices being used to carry out the scams.
Some reports indicate the group was allegedly running an illegal casino operation alongside the fraud ring.
Police noted that no passports were found on the arrested individuals during the operation.
The suspects are currently under interrogation as authorities work to determine the scale of the network and their nationalities.
caption:
63 foreign nationals arrested in a single building raid in Chattogram. No passports found.

The Counter Terrorism Unit (CTU) of the city police and Khulshi police arrested 63 foreign nationals in the Khulshi area of Chattogram city.

The suspects were found operating an international online fraud ring from a single building.

During the raid, police discovered various electronic devices being used to carry out the scams.

Some reports indicate the group was allegedly running an illegal casino operation alongside the fraud ring.

Police noted that no passports were found on the arrested individuals during the operation.

The suspects are currently under interrogation as authorities work to determine the scale of the network and their nationalities.
